name: Box MCP server
summary: Box's hosted Model Context Protocol server at mcp.box.com, which the vendor documents as letting "AI agents and apps search and use Box files over OAuth": 53 documented tools over files and folders, search, collaboration, Box AI question-answering and extraction, Hubs and Doc Gen. The human path comes first: an administrator enables the server in the Box Admin Console and, for a custom client, creates Integration Credentials (an OAuth client id and secret, a redirect URI and scopes). 16 of the 53 tools are off by default and need an admin to turn them on.

payments.notes: 2026-10-20: no 402 and no payment challenge on any surface read, and x402, mpp and 402 are absent from developer.box.com/llms.txt (30,405 bytes). www.box.com/pricing and the terms page answer 403 to this prober, so the human method is unread rather than absent.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-10-20 18:33Z, no credentials: initialize at mcp.box.com and at its /mcp path both answer 401 with a challenge naming one protected-resource document (200, 406 B), which names api.box.com as sole authorization server; its metadata advertises S256 only, no registration endpoint, no CIMD.
